metadata.question: Does Jabal Qidr have a darker color than Jabal Bayda, as observed in April 2024?

data.raw_code: The question: "Does Jabal Qidr have a darker color than Jabal Bayda, as observed in April 2024?" Interpretation: 1. Locations: Jabal Qidr and Jabal Bayda (both in Saudi Arabia based on my knowledge) - Jabal Qidr: ~27.333°N, 40.833°E - Jabal Bayda: ~27.667°N, 37.167°E 2. Time: April 2024 3. "Darker color" means lower surface reflectance/albedo. We should compare mean reflectance in visible bands. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 MSI (L2A) for April 2024 2. Cloud mask using S2 cloud probability 3. Calculate mean reflectance in visible bands (B2, B3, B4) for each location 4. Compare: If Jabal Qidr mean reflectance < Jabal Bayda mean reflectance → Yes (A), else No (B) Data quality considerations: - Check if images exist for both locations in April 2024 - Check if valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Validate reflectance values (should be 0-1 for surface reflectance) Fallback: If Sentinel-2 fails, try Landsat 9 (for April 2024) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var jabalQidr = ee.Geometry.Point([40.833, 27.333]); // Jabal Qidr, Saudi Arabia var jabalBayda = ee.Geometry.Point([37.167, 27.667]); // Jabal Bayda, Saudi Arabia var bufferRadius = 1000; // 1km buffer around points var geomQidr = jabalQidr.buffer(bufferRadius); var geomBayda = jabalBayda.buffer(bufferRadius); var startDate = '2024-04-01'; var endDate = '2024-04-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Sentinel-2 first var s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([jabalQidr, jabalBayda])); // Check if collection has data var colSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 as fallback var landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([jabalQidr, jabalBayda])); var landsatSize = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); if (landsatSize === 0) { print("No Sentinel-2 or Landsat images found in April 2024."); print("C1"); return; } else { // Use Landsat 9 var image = landsatCol.median(); // Landsat 9 surface reflectance bands (scaled by 0.0000275) var visBands = ['SR_B4', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B2']; // Red, Green, Blue var scaleFactor = 0.0000275; var offset = -0.2; // Calculate mean reflectance for each location var qidrVis = image.select(visBands) .multiply(scaleFactor).add(offset) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geomQidr, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var baydaVis = image.select(visBands) .multiply(scaleFactor).add(offset) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geomBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts var qidrCount = image.select(visBands[0]) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geomQidr, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(visBands[0]).getInfo(); var baydaCount = image.select(visBands[0]) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geomBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(visBands[0]).getInfo(); print("Using Landsat 9 (Apr 2024 median)"); print("Jabal Qidr pixels:", qidrCount, "Jabal Bayda pixels:", baydaCount); } } else { // Use Sentinel-2 with cloud masking // Add cloud probability from separate collection var cloudProbCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([jabalQidr, jabalBayda])); // Join S2 with cloud probability var joinedCol = ee.Join.saveFirst('cloud_prob').apply({ primary: s2Col, secondary: cloudProbCol, condition: ee.Filter.equals({ leftField: 'system:index', rightField: 'system:index' }) }); // Function to mask clouds function maskClouds(img) { var cloudProb = ee.Image(img.get('cloud_prob')).select('probability'); var mask = cloudProb.lt(20); // 20% cloud probability threshold return img.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); // Scale to 0-1 } var maskedCol = ee.ImageCollection(joinedCol.map(maskClouds)); var image = maskedCol.median(); // Sentinel-2 visible bands (B2, B3, B4) = Blue, Green, Red var visBands = ['B2', 'B3', 'B4']; // Calculate mean reflectance for each location var qidrVis = image.select(visBands) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geomQidr, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var baydaVis = image.select(visBands) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geomBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to check C2 var qidrCount = image.select(visBands[0]) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geomQidr, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(visBands[0]).getInfo(); var baydaCount = image.select(visBands[0]) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geomBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(visBands[0]).getInfo(); print("Using Sentinel-2 (Apr 2024 median)"); print("Images found:", colSize); print("Jabal Qidr valid pixels:", qidrCount); print("Jabal Bayda valid pixels:", baydaCount); } // Check for C2: No valid pixels if (qidrCount === 0 || baydaCount === 0) { if (qidrCount === 0) print("No valid pixels at Jabal Qidr."); if (baydaCount === 0) print("No valid pixels at Jabal Bayda."); print("C2"); return; } // Extract reflectance values var qidrValues = qidrVis.getInfo(); var baydaValues = baydaVis.getInfo(); // Calculate mean visible reflectance var qidrMean = (qidrValues[visBands[0]] + qidrValues[visBands[1]] + qidrValues[visBands[2]]) / 3; var baydaMean = (baydaValues[visBands[0]] + baydaValues[visBands[1]] + baydaValues[visBands[2]]) / 3; print("Jabal Qidr mean reflectance:", qidrMean.toFixed(4)); print("Jabal Bayda mean reflectance:", baydaMean.toFixed(4)); // Check for C3: Invalid values if (qidrMean === null || baydaMean === null || isNaN(qidrMean) || isNaN(baydaMean) || qidrMean < 0 || qidrMean > 1 || baydaMean < 0 || baydaMean > 1) { print("Invalid reflectance values detected."); print("C3"); return; } // Determine answer if (qidrMean < baydaMean) { print("Jabal Qidr is darker (lower reflectance)."); print("A"); } else { print("Jabal Qidr is not darker (equal or higher reflectance)."); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
